description: Decision-readiness register: what must be answered before any capital or competition decision. 'have' rows are answered with a source; 'missing' rows are blank with a discovery action. Nothing is inferred.

rows.question: Where can official, timestamped opening and closing prices for NFL markets be obtained?
rows.have: The NFL's official sports-betting data feed exists and is distributed by Genius Sports to operators and media (not to the public).
rows.missing: A licensed channel this project may use, with prices and capture timestamps.
rows.discovery: Survey licensed feeds (operator data APIs, licensed data resellers, regulator filings) and record terms; until then all market columns stay blank.
rows.blocks: REQ-01 market columns, REQ-04 difference, D1-CLV gate, official ROI

rows.question: What capture cadence turns one line snapshot into an open/close pair?
rows.have: One capture exists per originated game (model output generated from games through the prior week).
rows.missing: A scheduled second capture (e.g. kickoff minus 60 minutes) and its timestamps.
rows.discovery: Implement SG-03; store captured_utc per row per the price-store schema.

rows.question: Which originator is canonical when two committed pipelines publish different 'our' lines for the same game?
rows.have: data/derived/model.json (root lines page source) and results/originate.json (retired pipeline) differ by 1.5-9.0 points on all 15 slate games; both state positive = home favoured.
rows.missing: A maintainer decision naming one canonical file.
rows.discovery: Review the discrepancy table (FL-LD-07) and rule; see SG-05.

rows.question: How will the official results feed stay current after this session?
rows.have: 44 finals captured by hand with per-row official links; cross-check 27/27 against the committed snapshot.
rows.missing: An automated capture job (SG-02) and its owner.
rows.discovery: Prototype a parser on the pending week-1..6 URLs already recorded in results_feed.json.

rows.question: Does any official source publish depth charts (starter vs 2nd/3rd/4th string)?
rows.have: No: the league depth-chart path returns HTTP 404 and the official injury report has no depth column - both verified first-hand 2026-11-14.
rows.missing: An official (or club-official) depth order with a date stamp per club.
rows.discovery: SG-04: audit the 32 club sites; record URL + stamp; keep blank where none exists.

rows.question: What sample does the demotion gate need before it may act?
rows.have: Proposed: n >= 200 settled bets and a one-sided 95% upper bound below zero (mirrors price-store N_MIN).
rows.missing: A power analysis showing 200 is enough for the bet variance actually observed.
rows.discovery: Bootstrap the committed per-bet spreads to size n for 80% power at a 2% harm threshold.

rows.question: Are rewards funded, and in which jurisdiction may they be paid?
rows.have: Reward tiers are published as design text with 0 funding; sibling hubs flag the same gap.
rows.discovery: SG-08: decide paper-only vs funded pool; obtain jurisdiction review before any payout language goes live.

rows.question: Which ranking rule is canonical for the leaderboard?
rows.have: Root: 'gates, then ROI'. This desk: signal-only (gates, BH-adjusted p, raw p, n) with staking reported separately.
rows.missing: Maintainer decision; PS-F3 is open on the price-store board.
rows.discovery: Adopt SG-06; publish the chosen rule in one place and regenerate all leaderboards from it.

rows.question: How do parlays and player-prop combos score under signal vs staking?
rows.have: Root parlay scoring exists (data/derived/strategies.json parlay_scoring); sibling labs price correlated combos with measured correlations.
rows.missing: A signal metric for multi-leg tickets that does not lean on ROI (e.g. joint calibration vs implied).
rows.discovery: Define leg-level calibration error as the signal statistic for tickets; keep ticket ROI in the staking block.
rows.blocks: fair comparison of parlay strategies on the signal board

rows.question: Can closing-line value be measured at all before a price feed exists?
rows.have: No: CLV needs bet price and close price; the store has 0 market captures.
rows.discovery: Nothing to compute - keep D1 marked blocked rather than substituting a proxy.

rows.question: How many seasons of official standings should the correlation set cover?
rows.have: Two seasons transcribed (2025, 2026): 8 coefficients with n = 32/32/64.
rows.missing: A target precision decision (narrower CI = more seasons).
rows.discovery: SG-07: add seasons until every published CI half-width is acceptable to the reviewer.

rows.question: What time is the official injury report as-of each week?
rows.have: The Week 10 page shows practice and game status per player but carries no capture timestamp on the page.
rows.missing: The report's publication schedule/policy (the operations policy URL previously404'd for sibling sessions - not re-verified here).
rows.discovery: Record retrieval timestamps on every capture (done: retrieved_on fields) and find the league's policy page.

rows.question: How stale is the committed data snapshot, and what refresh cadence is acceptable?
rows.have: Extract as-of 2026-11-01 (README): Week 9 games carry blank scores there while NFL.com shows them final; our feed fills weeks 7-10 Thursday officially.
rows.missing: A refresh policy for data/derived (PR-based refresh workflows exist but were noted red/green by earlier sessions).
rows.discovery: Confirm the refresh workflow state on main and set a cadence; keep the as-of label visible everywhere.

rows.question: What is the signal-rank tie-break when BH-adjusted p is identical?
rows.have: All seven candidates share BH-adjusted p = 0.984847, so gates alone cannot order them; this desk proposes raw p asc, then decided n desc.
rows.missing: Reviewer acceptance of the tie-break (proposed, not standard).
rows.discovery: Accept or replace the rule; publish it next to the ranking rule.

rows.question: Is the Week 10 injury sample representative enough to publish?
rows.have: 4 clubs fully transcribed first-hand (WAS, NYG, NE, DET) out of the clubs on the report; every depth cell blank.
rows.missing: Full-report transcription (chunk 2-8) or a sibling ingest.
rows.discovery: Extend capture or point this desk's depth page at a sibling's fuller register after review.
